overview: Digital Twin Assembly Bottleneck Simulation addresses operational records arrive through different systems, supervisors reconstruct evidence manually, and decisions are difficult to audit in manufacturing operations. The first proof of value uses station cycle times, takt rates and WIP locations. It produces a reviewed operational recommendation and a traceable decision record. The commercial success measure is simulated versus actual throughput error, established from customer baseline data before any improvement is claimed.

scope:
Delivery model: Redington or approved implementation partner, eligibility and staffing pending confirmation.
Duration: Discovery and design first; pilot and rollout durations depend on data access and scope; no fixed commitment.
1) Discover source quality and baseline: station cycle times, takt rates and WIP locations; define simulated versus actual throughput error and data-processing boundary.
2) Design control points, security and connector contracts; obtain owner approval from Plant Manager / Operations Excellence Director.
3) Implement one bounded workflow, instrument missing-data exceptions and system-of-record write-back.
4) Test positive, negative, privilege, partial-data and rollback cases including line-by-line reconciliations against known business transactions.
5) Review KPI in the pilot, document evidence, perform training and agree transition.
